title: Example launches an open source coding assistant
content: Example released a public beta of its coding assistant today. The tool focuses on code review and local developer workflows.
author: Example Engineering

sources.title: Independent hands-on review
sources.excerpt: The reviewer tested the beta against two small Python projects.

ai_reason: The release could change how learners and junior developers approach code review.
ai_summary: Example released a public beta focused on code review and local workflows.
